notes: Sourced from Ross Video's own "AMX-8952-A, AMX-8952-B, and AMX-8952-C User Guide" (v6-rev5, official PDF over verified HTTPS from documentation.rossvideo.com), cross-checked against the Ross Video product page (rossvideo.com/products/signal-processing/opengear/timing-synchronization/amx-8952/) and Markertek's retail listing. The AMX-8952 family has three audio-interface variants sharing identical SDI/control architecture: -A (8x unbalanced 75ohm AES on HD-BNC), -B (this model: 8x balanced 110ohm AES on 3-pin WECO), -C (8x balanced analog audio on 3-pin WECO). Two interchangeable rear modules exist for -B — 8322R-330 (round screw-terminal AES footprint) and 8322AR-330-02 (WECO block-style footprint) — electrically identical, differing only in AES connector shape. SDI ports use HD-BNC (mini/DIN 1.0/2.3), not full-size BNC; the schema's closest id "sdi" was used. AES ports use proprietary 3-pin WECO(TM) balanced terminals, not a true captive-screw Euroblock; "euroblock" was chosen as the closest available connector id and flagged per-port. GPI/Tally ports are likewise 3-pin pluggable terminals, mapped to "euroblock" as the closest id even though they carry control contact-closures, not audio. This is an openGear rack-frame card (occupies 2 card slots) powered via the frame's card-edge/backplane connection — there is no standalone AC/DC power connector on the card itself, so no power port and no rackUnits value were set (max power draw is 20W per the manual's Power table). 12G-SDI/2160p UHD support requires the separately licensed AMX-8952-UHD-LICENSE key; base hardware is electrically rated up to SMPTE ST-2082 (11.88Gbps).
